description: This PHP source file defines a class 'charts' that includes functions related to generating charts for the Campaigns module in the SuiteCRM project. It contains a method for generating a campaign response chart based on campaign log data, incorporating database queries and template rendering.

classes.name: charts
classes.description: A class containing functions for generating campaign-related charts, currently including a response chart based on campaign log data.

methods.name: campaign_response_chart
methods.description: Generates a campaign response chart based on activity data from the campaign_log table, grouping by activity type and target type, and preparing the data for display in a template.
